author: Nerdstalgic
description:
At one point, Matt Damon was one of the most reliable movie stars in Hollywood.  From Good Will Hunting to The Bourne Identity, Damon built a career defined by smart choices, strong performances, and box office hits.

But then… everything almost went sideways.

With one of the worst movies produced in the 2010's, Matt Damon stepped into a huge international blockbuster that should have been a massive success.  After all, they had a legendary director, an enormous budget, and a built-in global audience.

Instead, it became one of the most controversial and confusing films of his career.  

#mattdamon #thegreatwall #jasonbourne #pedropascal #nerdstalgic
title: The Film That Almost Destroyed Matt Damon
